messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize the catalog retirement comms matrix and cohort windows for the Q3 migration. TL;DR: customers with pinned versions should get 90d notice; enterprise customers need a +private migration SLA. Thoughts?

sam: Agreed on a 90d baseline. Q: do we enforce auto-fallback to a compat-shim for hosted customers or leave migration responsibility to the client? :thinking: 

joel: From infra side we can provide auto-fallback for Hosted only. Dedicated/Private customers require opt-in because of network/KMS constraints. Need legal/contract check before making this default.

alex: Important: tie notice timing to billing cycle cutoff. If notice lands mid-cycle they effectively get less runway. Proposing a 'billing-safe window' flag on the rollout schedule.

emily: UX: Console banner + email + AM outreach. Banner should have two phases: soft (info) and hard (action required). Soft shows initial deprecation timeline, hard shows unblock steps + button to request extension.

maria: Can someone sketch the comm matrix rows? I put together a starter: 
- Tier: free/dev — 60d notice, auto-fallback to latest compatible, no SLA
- Tier: standard — 90d notice, auto-fallback opt-in, migration credits (one-time)
- Tier: enterprise — 120d notice + account manager outreach, auto-fallback OFF by default, opt-in migration support + SLA

sam: This looks solid. Need to add a "benchmark parity" gate: we shouldn't force-migrate if the new model fails acceptance checks (latency/quality). Where do those metrics live?

joel: Metrics live in Console / observability. I'll add a "quality regression flag" to the rollout API that will block or pause deprecation if thresholds are breached.

alex: We also need a pinned-version escape hatch for tenants that can't migrate on time: propose 6mo grace for a paid extension with reduced support. Legal to confirm if billing surcharge ok.

emily: UX: add an in-console CTA "Request pin extension" that opens a pre-filled support ticket for AMs. Also a visible ETA on what extension approvals look like.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Heads up — weekly release freeze starts Tue 03:00 UTC. Any rollout changes must be merged before then.

maria: Noted. Action items: @sam draft comm copy + migration credits details; @emily mock console banners & extension CTA; @joel define rollout API flags + gate checks and how the Console surfaces them; @alex run billing-window + surcharge impact; I'll loop in Legal & AMs. Can we get drafts by EOD Fri?

sam: I'll produce the comm copy draft by Fri EOD.

joel: I'll sketch the rollout API payload + gate behavior by Thu.

alex: I'll run a quick billing impact estimate and share numbers by Fri.

emily: Mockups by Thu EOD — will include soft/hard banners and the extension flow.

maria: Adding rollback criteria to the doc: automatic rollback if error rate increases >5% or p95 latency increases by >100ms sustained over 30m; rollback target should be the previous pinned model. I've added this to the draft: https://redwood.atlassian.com/RED-1234 — please comment. :rocket:

sam: Noted and will include in comms (we should be explicit about monitoring windows).

emily: UX question — how do we expose "migration credit" redeem? Inline coupon in Console vs invoice credit?

alex: For enterprise: invoice credit is simplest. For self-serve: coupon/redeem flow is better. We'll need Finance signoff for both.

joel: Tech note: compat-shim will add ~2-3% token overhead for long shared prefixes. Add that into the cost disclosure in comms.

maria: Good catch — add a short line in the matrix about expected cost delta for shim fallback.

maria: OK — reconvene Mon 10:00am PT to approve final copy. If anyone can't make it, post updates in the doc.

sam: :thumbsup:
